project.name: Japan Cannabinoid Trends
project.description: A reproducible longitudinal research project for collecting, validating, processing, analyzing, and publishing data about cannabinoid-related trends in Japan.

scope.population: Publicly observable cannabinoid-related search, social, web, analytics, and market signals relevant to Japan

objectives.primary: Build a reproducible longitudinal dataset for observing cannabinoid-related trends in Japan.
secondary: Measure changes in cannabinoid-related interest over time
Compare signals across multiple platforms and data sources
Preserve historical observations for longitudinal analysis
Produce reproducible research reports and datasets
Separate raw observations from interpretation and publication

googleTrends.notes: MCP server: google-trends-mcp (npm, no API key). Skill: research-google-trends

queryDesign.principle: MECE: Each compound has unique queries per media type, avoiding overlap

youtube.marketRestriction: Japanese product term リキッド gives an approximate query-language market restriction; this is not a geographic guarantee.
youtube.note: Liquid-only primary design is declared per study (datasets/<study>/metadata/query-design.json). The legacy max_videos parameter belongs to the previous actor and is not used for new collection.

The source paths below therefore point to non-distributed local files. The per-compound entries, summary and known issues below record the 2026-10-23 view; they are not a 36-term coverage table.
